key_findings: ISM listing pages are useful for discovery but should not be stored as program records.
Bachelor and master English programs both require B2 language proficiency; reviewed pages do not expose numeric TOEFL/IELTS cutoffs.
The M.Sc. International Management page requires 180 ECTS, with 210 ECTS for Fast Track, plus economics/business background or 30 ECTS in business sciences.
ISM MBA pages state GMAT score does not matter, and MBA admission is centered on first degree, work experience, English B2, and interviews/case study.
known_gaps: This LLM-native pass records only official detail/application pages read directly: B.Sc. International Management, M.Sc. International Management, MBA full-time, and MBA part-time.
Other English on-campus, online, and German-language ISM programs listed on overview pages were not expanded into records without opening their own requirement pages.
MBA document checklist and exact application deadlines were not found in the reviewed official pages.
